blind.description: A low, conical mound of fused industrial slag or volcanic clinker. The mass consists of glossy, vitrified black globules, smooth molten dribbles, and porous, vesicular earthy chunks with mottled rusty-brown and dark charcoal surfaces. Pits and cavities perforate the rough faces, giving it an authentic porous cinder texture. The mound rests directly on the floor without an added plinth or base.
blind.from_above: A roughly circular, bumpy cluster of fused bubbly nodules and pitted rock fragments with dark glassy flows over rust-tinted earthy stone.
blind.height_vs_figure: About one-third as tall as the figure (around 1.8 to 2 feet high) and roughly 2.5 to 3 feet in diameter.

notes: Low-contrast pile may occasionally be mistaken for a dung pile at tabletop distance
